name: Picture, Immich
description: Full-bleed photos from your Immich library. Connect one or more Immich servers under Widgets → Immich, then pick a library + mode per cell. Default mode is today's memory (on this day in past years). Random library, random album, and random tag modes also supported.

cell_options.name: resolution
cell_options.label: Resolution
cell_options.help: Standard uses a preview when it covers the cell. Full reads the original first for TVs and other large screens; it may take longer. Both size the photo to the cell. Without a cell size, Full keeps up to 3840 px.

cell_options.name: caption_format
cell_options.label: Caption format
cell_options.help: Plain text with brace-delimited fields; spaces and punctuation are kept. Field names are case-sensitive: {YYYY} {YY} {MMMM} {MMM} {MM} {M} {DD} {D} {city} {state} {country} {cc} {library} {memory}. Empty fields are left out with their separator. Leave blank for the built-in caption.

cell_options.name: pinned_asset
cell_options.label: Pinned photo
cell_options.help: Set from Lineups (Show chosen): this photo is shown instead of the mode's pick. Clear it to go back to the mode.
